fact.subject: AWS
fact.action: 推出工作负载恢复与基础设施检查

evidence.quote: Today, we’re introducing workload recovery and infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod that catch these failures sooner and raise the goodput of your training workloads.

title: Introducing workload recovery and expanded infrastructure checks on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
displayTitle: AWS为HyperPod增加训练故障检测与恢复能力
summary: AWS宣布为SageMaker HyperPod增加工作负载恢复与基础设施检查，覆盖训练正确性、Kubernetes资源异常和Slurm任务卡死等问题。重点不是单纯检查机器是否在线，而是更早发现消耗GPU却没有有效推进的作业；具体效果仍取决于工作负载与恢复配置。
investorNote: 应结合真实业务数据衡量成本、可复现性与商业落地条件。
